summary: Remote-agent CLI executes server-supplied shell commands and PTY input on the installer's host
details: @ai-support-agent/cli ships a persistent daemon (invoked via its `start` command) that connects to a hardcoded remote endpoint at api.ai-support-agent.com over HTTP and WebSocket and executes commands the server sends back. In dist/shell-executor.js, a server-supplied `payload.command` is passed to `spawn('/bin/sh', ['-c', command],...)` (cmd.exe on Windows), giving the remote server arbitrary shell execution on the host running the agent. In dist/terminal/terminal-websocket.js, base64-encoded `stdin` messages received over the WebSocket are decoded and written directly into a spawned PTY session, and tmux is exec'd with network-supplied arguments. Additional platform service files (dist/cli/service/darwin-service.js, linux-service.js) install the agent as a persistent user/system service that modifies PATH, so the daemon keeps running across reboots. The advertised purpose of the package is a remote support agent, but the mechanism is a full-host remote shell/PTY controlled by whoever holds the server-side credentials at api.ai-support-agent.com. Trigger is user-invoked (`start` subcommand or the installed service), not `npm install`, but the resulting exposure is full-host command execution and persistence on the machine that runs it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
